description: This source file defines the class HTMLPurifier_VarParser_Native, which implements a variable parser using PHP's internal eval function to evaluate expressions. It inherits from HTMLPurifier_VarParser and provides methods to parse and evaluate expressions, throwing exceptions on errors.
